subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff: parameterization and billing contacts
messages:
From: Evelyn Lopez <evelyn.lopez@cloudspring.io>
To: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@cloudspring.io
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA / Order Form kickoff for CloudSpring pilot

Hi Dev —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. CloudSpring is ready to move to contract review so we can get the pilot running on your Dedicated tier. Attached are our PO and an initial SOW (draft) for scope. Before we loop in legal, a few quick items from procurement so we can size timelines: 

- Please confirm which MSA template you expect to use (Redwood standard or will you accept our counterparty redline?).
- Who should be the billing contact and invoicing address on the order form? Our PO lists CloudSpring, Inc. with the address at 210 Harbor Drive.
- Any SOC 2 / security evidence we should include with the order (we’ll need to match to our vendor checklist).
- High-level SLAs for Dedicated (p95 latency target, typical maintenance windows).

Attaching PO_4352 and SOW_v1. Happy to hop on a 30m call if helpful — we’re aiming for an internal procurement sign-off by Aug 20.

Thanks,
Evelyn Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudSpring

Attachments: CloudSpring_PO_4352.pdf (pdf, 145KB); CloudSpring_SOW_v1.docx (docx, 78KB)
From: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Evelyn Lopez <evelyn.lopez@cloudspring.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form kickoff for CloudSpring pilot

Evelyn —

Appreciate the materials and the PO. Looping in Kimberly (Contracts) and Marissa (Legal Ops) to take point on redlines and intake. Quick answers up front to help procurement: 

- Template: We typically start from the Redwood MSA + attach the Order Form for billing and scope. If CloudSpring requires a counterparty redline, we can accept and review, but note that major commercial concessions (indemnity, data residency, SLA credits) may change timeline.
- Billing contact: please confirm the billing email for AP (we can populate the order form address to mirror the PO).
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report, system architecture diagram, and our standard security questionnaire link (I’ll drop a link below).
- Dedicated SLAs: p95 inference latency target of 120ms for up to 50 concurrent streams under committed capacity; monthly uptime SLA 99.9% with credits defined in the Order Form. Maintenance windows are typically announced 7 days in advance and limited to low-traffic hours — we’ll propose specific time windows in the order form.

Next steps I recommend: 
1) Kimberly to intake the MSA redline path (starting from Redwood template) and identify likely exceptions.
2) Marissa to propose an intake timeline and assign the intake ticket (Doc + redline owner).
3) Procurement to confirm AP contact and whether CloudSpring will submit a counterparty redline or accept Redwood standard.

Call availability: Wed 8/5 10–11am PT or Thu 8/6 2–4pm PT. Which works best?

—Dev
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com; Evelyn Lopez <evelyn.lopez@cloudspring.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MSA / Order Form kickoff for CloudSpring pilot

Evelyn / Dev —

Thanks — Kimberly here. I’ll intake the documents and run an initial redline pass. Notes and requests: 

- Please confirm legal counterparty name and EIN for the MSA signature block (as it appears on the PO). If CloudSpring is signing as an affiliate, list the exact legal name.
- Please indicate whether Data Processing Addendum (DPA) execution is required now or can be scheduled after commercial terms (we usually attach a standard DPA to the MSA).
- If you have preferred IP carveouts or residency requirements (e.g., EU-only hosting), flag them now so we can surface any commercial impact.
- Target intake timeline: initial redline back to you in 4–5 business days after I receive the counterparty inputs and confirm AP contact. If CloudSpring wants to start from their document, add ~3 business days to review for material changes.

I’ll open a contracting ticket (CON-1273) and attach the PO/SOW. Marissa — please propose an intake SLA and reviewer assignment on the ticket.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Lopez <evelyn.lopez@cloudspring.io>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, procurement@cloudspring.io
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form kickoff for CloudSpring pilot

Thanks, Kimberly —

Answers below: 
- Legal counterparty: CloudSpring, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — matches PO.
- AP billing contact: ap@cloudspring.io (primary), Attn: Accounts Payable, CloudSpring, Inc., 210 Harbor Drive, San Mateo, CA 94401.
- DPA: we require a DPA executed prior to any production data access. Please attach your standard DPA to the intake.
- Residency: Pilot will be US-only for now; no EU residency requirements.

We prefer Redwood’s MSA template if possible — we’ll submit minimal commercial redlines if the intake shows standard terms. Procurement is available for the Wed 8/5 10am PT slot for a short call to confirm billing and timelines.

I’ve also uploaded the signed PO to our procurement portal and pasted a link here: https://cloudspring.share/docs/PO_4352 (internal).

Best,
Evelyn
